description: This PHP source file defines the Store controller for the admin panel of an OpenCart project. It manages store settings including listing, editing, form display, saving, deleting, and rebuilding store data.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: The Store class handles all administrative operations related to store configurations in the OpenCart backend, including listing stores, editing store details, handling forms, saving changes, deleting stores, and rebuilding store data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: renders the main store list page with header, footer, and navigation components, and passes store data to the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: returns a simplified view output of the store list, primarily for AJAX or partial refresh requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: retrieves and assembles store list data with pagination details and returns the appropriate view for store listing.

methods.name: form
methods.description: displays the store creation/edit form populated with existing data if editing, or defaults for new store creation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: handles POSTed form data to create or update store information, along with validation, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: deletes selected stores after validation checks, and responds with success or error messages in JSON format.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: rebuilds or resets store-specific data; currently partial implementation, meant to delete and recreate store settings.
